answer: Shards are assigned from the atlas graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The raven assignment is published and trellis records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4945 identities would post 564 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
